questions.question: In a certain code language, PLACARD is coded as 29-3-23, and DORMATS is coded as 37-13-40. How will CONFUSE be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Sum of first three alphabet positional value - Fourth alphabet positional value - Sum of last three alphabet positional value.**

PLACARD is coded as 29-3-23.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f38749b37fd50982ef31971df09b059353b2270a8990c446de9208348572cf0c.png] 

= (16 + 12 + 1) - 3 - (1 + 18 + 4)

= 29-3-23

And

DORMATS is coded as 37-13-40.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/353aa86bb9b1dd06c335abebebb95f8573e5ebb9a1e53111a6fb9320af3b7116.png] 

= (4 + 15 + 18) - 13 - (1 + 20 + 19)

= 37-13-40

Similarly,

CONFUSE will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f702d7ffffa089b193a25f1a768cdc8e74ee536fa99bf3804faf0a5a466121d6.png] 

**= (3 + 15 + 14) - 6 - (21 + 19 + 5)**

**= 32-6-45**

Hence, the correct answer is **"32-6-45".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

85 : 6 :: 97 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Second number = (First digit of number - Second digit of number) × 2**

85 : 6 → (8 - 5) × 2 = 3 × 2 = 6

Similarly,

97 : ? → **(9 - 7) × 2 = 2 × 2 = 4**

Hence, the correct answer is **"4".**

Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

questions.solution:

2) O D C T C → D **O** C T - **D** O **C** T - D O C **T** - D O **C** T

 
• Here **"DOCT"** is repeated.

3) O D T T C → D **O** C T - **D** O **T** T - D O C **T** - D O **C** T

4) O D C T D → D **O** C T - **D** O **C** T - D O C **T** - D O **D** T

 
• Option (2) gives the pattern of :- D O C T - D O C T - D O C T - D O C T

Hence, the correct answer is **"O D C T C".**

questions.question:
If '+' represents '×', '−' represents '+', '×' represents '÷' and '÷' represents '−', then what will be the value of the following expression?

47 + 12 ÷ 288 × 18
questions.solution:
By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74705c2850be4128d24e4566153625c8bd9b12cbf6ea7ad34a1817e44ebdc0db.png] 

Given :-

 
 

 Symbols
 Stands for
 
 

 +
 × 
 
 

 -
 +
 
 

 × 
 ÷ 
 
 

 ÷ 
 -
 
 

Given expression : 47 + 12 ÷ 288 × 18

After interchanging the given symbols the expression formed is : 

= 47 × 12 - __**288 ÷ 18**__

= __**47 × 12**__ - 16

= __**564 - 16**__

**= 548**

Hence, the correct answer is **"548".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All clothes are flowers.

Some flowers are vegetables.

Conclusions:

I. Some flowers are clothes.

II. Some vegetables are flowers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e854f709adfbb0b28a956136705aefac59c1e66bdaea788e1a55aea1a2884488.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some flowers are clothes → True (As All clothes are flowers so, Some flowers are clothes is true)

II. Some vegetables are flowers → True (As Some flowers are vegetables so, Some vegetables are flowers is true)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow".**
